description: This file provides utility functions for data validation and transformation within a software project, specifically for handling JSON data. It includes functions to validate required fields and apply mapping transformations to JSON structures.

methods.name: list[str] validate_required(data: Dict[str, Any], required: list[str])
methods.description: Checks which required keys are missing or null in a given dictionary.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] apply_mapping(nb_json: Dict[str, Any], mapping_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Transforms input JSON data to a different structure based on a provided mapping specification, supporting nested fields.

methods.name: set_nested(d: Dict[str, Any], path: str, value: Any)

ctags.name: apply_mapping
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_mapping(nb_json: Dict[str, Any], mapping_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: get_nested
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_nested(d: Dict[str, Any], path: str):$/

ctags.name: set_nested
ctags.pattern: /^    def set_nested(d: Dict[str, Any], path: str, value: Any):$/
ctags.signature: (d: Dict[str, Any], path: str, value: Any)

ctags.name: validate_required
ctags.pattern: /^def validate_required(data: Dict[str, Any], required: list[str]) -> list[str]:$/
